verdict.rationale: Hatchet has programmatic surfaces: SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Go and Ruby, including SDK methods to create and manage cron triggers and evaluate CEL expressions, plus an official CLI with a TUI for observability and profile management. However, nothing documents that the API matches everything the UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a documented REST/OpenAPI reference covering all UI operations, and independent corroboration that UI-only actions are available programmatically.
